aichat: get a concrete task done with an AI chat assistant (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Copilot): pose a real task — draft an email, plan a trip, summarize a document, write or fix something, generate an image — iterate on the response at least once, and end with a usable result; complete when the refined result is on screen and accepted (copied, downloaded, or applied). Surface pinned: the assistant's own chat interface — not news about AI, not prompt-tips listicles without a live session.
aiimage: generate an image with an AI image tool (Midjourney, DALL-E / ChatGPT images, Canva AI, Adobe Firefly, Ideogram): write a prompt toward a concrete goal, review the candidates, iterate at least once — revise the prompt, vary, upscale, or edit — and download or export the chosen result; complete when the download/export of the final image is shown. Surface pinned: the generation tool's own session — not AI-news commentary, not prompt-listicle slideshows without a live session.
amazon: buy a physical product on Amazon: search for an item, work the results list, open and assess a product page (price, rating, variant options, delivery date), add to cart, and check out; complete when the order confirmation or the final checkout review screen with the order total is on screen. Surface pinned: Amazon's own website or app — not a third-party wrapper or assistive shopping app, not a haul/unboxing video, not a deals-roundup or affiliate-listicle without a live purchase session. Variants: returns and refunds (see returns), reordering a past purchase (see reorder), leaving a review (see review), and Amazon Fresh grocery orders (see groceries) do not belong.
animation: create an animation in an animation tool (Canva animate, After Effects, CapCut, Alight Motion, PowerPoint morph): animate a concrete element — a text animation, logo reveal, or keyframed/preset motion — preview it, and export; complete when the export finishes or the final animation plays back inside the session. Surface pinned: the animation-authoring session — not animation-appreciation or breakdown videos. AI animation generators are off-task: the arc must be manual keyframe or preset authoring.
apartment: search for an apartment and contact the listing (Zillow, Apartments.com, Trulia): set location, price, and bedroom filters, evaluate listings and their trustworthiness, pick candidates, send an inquiry or tour request; complete when the inquiry-sent or tour-request confirmation is on screen. Surface pinned: an apartment-listing website or app. Variants: submitting a rental application with documents, roommate finding, and buying a home do not belong.
autopay: set up autopay or an alert (bank and credit-card autopay, price or balance alerts): navigate to the payments or alerts settings, configure what fires and when — amount, date, threshold, funding source — save, and verify it shows as armed; complete when the confirmation that the standing order or alert is active is on screen. Surface pinned: a bank, card, retailer, or utility website/app settings area. Variants: making a one-time bill payment, and cancelling an existing autopay, do not belong.
banking: carry out an everyday banking task in a bank's own website or app (Chase, Bank of America, Wells Fargo, Capital One, a credit union): sign in, then complete one concrete arc — transfer money between accounts, deposit a check with the camera, or find and download/read a statement — through the bank's review-and-confirm step; complete when the bank's confirmation of the transfer or deposit (or the opened statement) is on screen. Surface pinned: the bank's own app or site — not p2p apps (Venmo/Cash App belong to the p2p domain), not budgeting apps, not crypto exchanges.
billpay: pay a bill through a bank or biller portal (bank bill pay, utility, credit-card, phone-company sites): log in, locate the bill or add the payee, set the amount and payment date, pick the funding account, submit; complete when the payment-scheduled or payment-confirmed screen is on screen. Surface pinned: a bank's bill-pay interface or a biller's own web/app payment portal. Variants: setting up recurring autopay, sending money to a person, and paying at a store register do not belong.
calendly: land a meeting time with another person through a scheduling tool (Calendly, Doodle, Microsoft Bookings): open the invite link — or set up the event/poll and get it answered — compare availability, pick a slot, confirm; complete when the meeting-confirmed screen, or the poll's agreed final time, is on screen with the event details. Either side of the handshake belongs as long as the recording reaches a confirmed time. Surface pinned: a scheduling tool on the web. Variants: emailing back and forth about times, plain calendar-event creation with no counterparty, and configuring availability settings without a resulting booking do not belong.
cancelsub: cancel a subscription (Netflix, gym and streaming services, app-store subscriptions): sign in, find the buried cancel path in account settings — or the phone's subscription manager — click through the retention offers, confirm; complete when the cancellation confirmation showing the service end date is on screen. Surface pinned: the service's website/app account settings or the phone's subscription-manager screen. Variants: pausing or downgrading a plan, deleting the account entirely, and disputing a charge do not belong.
carinsurance: get a car-insurance quote online and proceed toward buying the policy: enter vehicle and driver details, choose coverage options and deductibles, review the quote price, and continue toward purchase; complete when a priced quote (or a purchase confirmation) is on screen. Surface pinned: an insurer's quote website or app (GEICO, Progressive, State Farm, Allstate, Root). Variants: insurance-agent sales training, "cheapest insurance" talking-head advice, and claims filing do not belong.
classreg: register for a class through a school's registration portal (university and community-college student portals, community-ed sites): search the course catalog, check open seats and schedule fit, add the course to the cart or schedule, enroll and pay if required; complete when the enrolled schedule or registration confirmation is on screen. Surface pinned: a web registration portal. Variants: applying for admission, financial-aid forms, and buying self-paced MOOC courses (Udemy, Coursera) do not belong.
crafts: design a craft project in cutting-machine software (Cricut Design Space, Silhouette Studio): choose or upload a design, size and arrange it on the virtual mat, set the material, mirror where needed (iron-on), and send the project to the machine or reach the ready-to-cut confirmation; complete when the cut job is sent or the make-it/ready screen confirms the prepared job. Surface pinned: the design-software session — machine unboxings, material reviews, and finished-project showcases without the software arc are off-task.
creditcard: apply for a credit card online as a consumer: open the card's apply page, fill the application (personal info, income, SSN-type identity fields), review disclosures and terms, submit, and see the decision or "under review" state; complete when the application-submitted or decision screen is on screen. Surface pinned: a bank or card issuer's website or app (Chase, Discover, Capital One, Amex, Citi, Bank of America). Variants: "best credit cards" rankings and reviews, credit-repair content, activating or using a card, and business payment-processing (merchant) content do not belong.
dating: set up and use a dating app or site (Tinder, Bumble, Hinge, Match, OkCupid): create or edit the profile with photos and prompts, set preferences and filters, browse candidates and act on them, and reach a match or send a first message where the flow allows; complete when the match screen or the sent first message is shown. Surface pinned: the dating product itself — not dating-advice talking-head content, not story-time videos about dates.
deleteacct: permanently delete an online account (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, any service): find the buried deletion path in settings or the privacy/GDPR data-deletion request page, verify identity or re-enter the password, acknowledge what will be lost, confirm; complete when the deletion-confirmed screen — or deletion-scheduled with its grace-period date — is on screen. Surface pinned: the service's website or app settings. Variants: temporary deactivation, unsubscribing from marketing emails, and cancelling a paid subscription do not belong.
devicesetup: set up a new device through its companion app or on-device flow: a new phone (setup, account sign-in, data transfer), a router or mesh Wi-Fi via its app, a smartwatch pairing, or a smart-home device (camera, plug, speaker, doorbell): the unbox-to-working arc — pair or connect, sign in, configure the essentials; complete when the device shows working/connected in the app or the phone reaches its fully set-up home screen. Surface pinned: the setup flow itself — not unboxing-only or review videos.
dispute: dispute a charge or report a fraudulent transaction on a bank, card, or payment account (Chase, Bank of America, Capital One, PayPal, Cash App): find the transaction in the account activity, open the dispute/report flow, pick the reason (unauthorized charge, wrong amount, item not received), answer the flow's questions, submit, and see the claim-submitted confirmation with a claim/reference state; complete when the dispute-submitted confirmation is on screen. Surface pinned: a bank, card, or payment app's dispute flow. Variants: general fraud-awareness or scam-story content, chargeback tutorials aimed at merchants, credit-repair content, and calling-the-bank-only videos with no on-screen flow do not belong.
dmv: renew a driver's license or vehicle registration on a state DMV portal: verify identity and eligibility, work through the renewal form, pay the fee; complete when the renewal-submitted confirmation — receipt or temporary document — is on screen. Surface pinned: a state DMV web portal, not an in-office visit vlog. Variants: address change (seeded variant), first-time license applications, REAL ID upgrades, and driving-test booking do not belong.
doctor: book a doctor appointment online (Zocdoc, MyChart and other patient portals, clinic sites): search or pick a provider, filter by insurance and visit reason, pick an open slot, identify as the patient, confirm; complete when the appointment confirmation with provider, date, and time is on screen. Surface pinned: a medical booking site or patient portal on web or app. Variants: prescription refills (seeded variant), attending the telehealth visit itself, and researching providers without booking do not belong.
donate: make a donation online (GoFundMe, charity websites, donation platforms): pick the campaign or organization, choose an amount and one-time vs monthly, enter payment details, handle the platform-tip step if shown, commit; complete when the thank-you / donation receipt is on screen. Surface pinned: a fundraising platform or charity website. Variants: starting your own fundraiser, Kickstarter-style reward pledges, and donating goods in person do not belong.
download: find and download a specific file (a government form PDF, a bank statement, a schedule/timetable PDF, a paper, a receipt/invoice): locate the artifact on the site, trigger the download, and verify the file actually arrived (the downloads bar or downloads folder shows the right file); complete when the downloaded file is visible in the downloads UI or opened. Surface pinned: any site's download flow plus the browser's download UI. Variants: piracy/torrent content, download-manager-software ads, and "how to download YouTube videos" (rights-violating rips) do not belong.
ebay: bid on an eBay auction as a buyer: find an auction listing, review item condition, seller rating, and shipping, place a bid by setting a maximum bid, confirm the bid, and see the resulting bid status; complete when the bid-confirmed state ("You're the highest bidder" or "You've been outbid") is on screen. Surface pinned: the eBay website or app. Variants: selling or listing items, dropshipping/reselling content, "Buy It Now" only purchases (that is ordinary shopping), and sniping-tool promotions do not belong.
email: compose and send an email in a mail client (Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo Mail, Apple Mail): open compose, address the recipient, write the subject and body, optionally attach a file, send it, and verify it in Sent; complete when the message shows as sent. Surface pinned: the mail client's compose-and-send flow — not inbox-organizing tours, not newsletter/marketing tools, not email-etiquette advice videos.
fines: pay a fine or ticket on a government portal (city parking-ticket sites, court or toll-violation portals): look up the citation by number or plate, verify the details match the notice, pay; complete when the payment receipt or confirmation is on screen. Surface pinned: a city, court, or agency web payment portal. Variants: contesting or appealing a ticket, DMV renewals, and paying ordinary toll-account balances do not belong.
flights: book a flight online (Google Flights, airline websites and apps, Expedia, Kayak): search a route and dates, compare fares and times, pick an outbound and return, enter passenger details, and reach the payment or confirmation step; complete when a booking confirmation or itinerary summary with the fare total is on screen. Surface pinned: a flight-booking site or airline app — not an airport kiosk, not a travel vlog, not a points/miles explainer without a live booking session. Variants: checking in for a flight (see checkin), researching and comparing without booking (see itinerary), and hotel or car add-ons after the flight is booked do not belong.
govbenefits: apply for a government benefit online or manage an existing claim (unemployment insurance, SNAP/food stamps, disability, Medicaid, housing assistance — state portals and agency sites): work through the eligibility screens and application form and submit, or certify/check an existing claim; complete when the submission confirmation or the claim-status screen is shown. Surface pinned: the government benefits portal itself — not benefit-explainer talking heads without a portal session.
graphicdesign: create a graphic design in a design tool (Canva, Adobe Express, Figma, Photoshop): start from a template or blank canvas toward a concrete artifact — a flyer, poster, invitation, social post, logo, or thumbnail — customize text, images, colors, and layout, and export or download it; complete when the export/download confirmation or the finished file is shown. Surface pinned: the design-tool session — not design-theory videos, not portfolio showcases. AI-generation flows (Canva Magic Design, text-to-image design generators) are off-task: the arc must be manual template or canvas editing.
groceries: order groceries for delivery on a grocery delivery service (Instacart, Walmart, Amazon Fresh): search for items, compare options and prices, add to cart, pick a delivery window, check out; complete when an order confirmation with the delivery window is on screen. Surface pinned: the web or mobile-app interface of a grocery delivery service — not in-store shopping footage or a recipe/meal-prep video. Variants: ordering for store/curbside pickup, restaurant takeout, receiving the delivery at the door, and meal-kit subscriptions do not belong.
healthinfo: look up specific health information online and judge its reliability (Mayo Clinic, WebMD, NIH/MedlinePlus, NHS): search a symptom, condition, or medication question, open results, distinguish reputable medical sources from ads and content farms, read the relevant section, and cross-check at least one second source; complete when the answer is on screen from an identified reputable source. Surface pinned: health-information websites reached through search. Variants: personal medical-record portals (that is a different task), telehealth appointment booking, health influencer/talking-head advice videos, and supplement marketing do not belong.
healthinsurance: shop for or enroll in a health insurance plan online (healthcare.gov, a state exchange, an employer open-enrollment portal, the Medicare plan finder): enter household and income details where asked, compare plans on premium, deductible, and network, select a plan and proceed toward enrollment; complete when the enrollment confirmation or the plan-selection summary is on screen. Surface pinned: the marketplace or enrollment flow — not insurance-explainer talking heads (that is policyinfo-class content).
hotel: book a hotel room online (Booking.com, Expedia, hotel brand sites): search destination and dates, compare properties and rates, pick a room and rate plan, enter guest and payment details, book; complete when the reservation confirmation with dates and a confirmation number is on screen. Surface pinned: a hotel-booking website or app. Variants: Airbnb-style stays that require host approval, booking flights, and cancelling an existing reservation do not belong.
itinerary: research and assemble travel options for a specific trip using travel-planning tools (Google Flights, Google Travel/Maps, Skyscanner, Kayak, Rome2Rio): search flights for dates, compare times, prices, and stops, check hotels or things-to-do for the same dates, and gather a shortlist of concrete options with prices — the person makes the final call, so booking is NOT required; complete when a compared set of options (e.g. a flights list filtered/sorted, tracked prices, or a saved shortlist) is on screen. Surface pinned: travel-search and planning tools in a browser or app. Variants: destination vlogs/guides ("top 10 things in Rome"), booking-only videos with no comparison (the hotel and flights domains cover booking), and travel-hacking/points content do not belong.
jobs: apply to a job online (Indeed, Workday, LinkedIn Easy Apply, company career portals): find the posting, start the application, fill the multi-page form, upload or attach a resume, answer the screening questions, submit; complete when the application-submitted confirmation is on screen. Surface pinned: a job board or employer application portal on the web. Variants: resume writing, job-search browsing without submitting, and interview preparation do not belong.
lookup: look up a specific parameterized public fact and read off the right value: enter the identifying parameters (a place and day for a weather forecast on weather.com or accuweather, a flight number on flightaware or the airline's site, a route and time on a transit-schedule site, a team for a sports score, a channel for a TV listing), get the result for those parameters, and read the needed value; complete when the queried value for the RIGHT parameters (right city, right flight number, right date, right route) is on screen. Surface pinned: a public information site or app (weather, flight-status, transit-schedule, sports scores, TV listings). Variants: news commentary or analysis videos, storm-chasing/weather-event footage, sports highlight reels, and app "review" content do not belong.
mapnav: get directions to a specific place with an online map (Google Maps, Apple Maps, Waze): search the destination, pick a travel mode, review the route options (time, tolls, transit lines), and start navigation or read off the chosen route; complete when the chosen route with its ETA is on screen or turn-by-turn navigation has begun. Surface pinned: the map product itself — not dashcam or driving footage, not travel vlogs that happen to show a map.
marketplace: strike a deal on a peer-to-peer marketplace (Facebook Marketplace, eBay, Craigslist): browse listings, assess the item and the counterparty's trustworthiness, message or bid/make an offer, agree on price and handoff, and commit — platform checkout or an agreed pickup in the message thread; complete when a purchase confirmation, accepted offer, or agreed deal in messages is on screen. Selling — listing an item and closing with a buyer — is the same ask from the other side and belongs. Surface pinned: a marketplace website or app. Variants: booking a service visit (seeded variant), retail shopping on Amazon-style stores, and apartment hunting do not belong.
message: send a message that commits you to something, addressed to a specific person (Gmail, Outlook, LinkedIn): draft the email or DM — an outreach, RSVP, request, or reply that creates an obligation — address it to the right recipient, review it as the recipient will read it, send, and verify it shows as sent; complete when the sent state (Sent folder or sent thread) is on screen. Surface pinned: an email client or LinkedIn/professional messaging on web or app. Variants: casual chat with friends, public posts, and mass newsletters do not belong.
news: find the latest news about a specific topic (a company, a person, a sport, a technology) on a news site or aggregator (google news, apnews, reuters, bbc, espn): search for or navigate to the topic, sort by or judge recency, and open the relevant latest article; complete when a current article on the right topic is on screen. Surface pinned: news sites and aggregators. Variants: news commentary/opinion videos as the subject, and "daily news recap" videos where a person reads headlines to camera, do not belong.
p2p: send money to a person on a payment app (Venmo, Zelle, Cash App, PayPal): pick or add the recipient, enter the amount and note, review the recipient and amount at the pre-send screen — the no-undo moment — and send; complete when the sent confirmation / completed payment is on screen. Surface pinned: a payment app or a bank app's send-money screen, mobile or web. Variants: requesting money or splitting a bill (seeded variant), paying a merchant at checkout, and bank-to-bank account transfers do not belong.
patientportal: use a patient portal (MyChart, FollowMyHealth, LabCorp or Quest portals, a health system's own portal): sign in and complete one concrete arc — view test results, read or send a message to the care team, view or download a visit summary or medical record, or check in for an upcoming visit; complete when the result, message, or record is on screen. Surface pinned: the portal itself — not symptom research (healthinfo), not appointment booking (doctor), not pharmacy refills (refill).
playlist: add specific songs to a playlist on a music or video service as a listener: search for a specific song or artist, create a named playlist or open an existing one, add the song(s) to it, and open the playlist to verify the right tracks now appear in the right playlist; complete when the playlist visibly contains the added track(s). Surface pinned: a music or video service's app or site (Spotify, YouTube Music, Apple Music, YouTube). Variants: music-production or DJ content, "top 100 songs" countdowns, playlist-promotion/marketing for artists, and speaker/hardware setup do not belong.
presentation: build a slide presentation in a slides tool (Google Slides, PowerPoint, Canva presentations, Keynote): create from a template or blank, add and edit slides with text and images, apply a theme or layouts, and finish by presenting, sharing, or exporting; complete when present mode, the share confirmation, or the export is shown. Surface pinned: the manual slides-authoring session — AI deck generators (Gamma, Tome, one-click AI features) are OFF-task, as is presentation-skills advice without an authoring session.
privacy: change privacy or account settings and verify they took effect (Google privacy checkup / activity controls, Facebook or Instagram privacy settings, TikTok privacy, iPhone app permissions): open the settings, find the specific control (ad personalization, private/public account, location access, activity history), change it, and confirm the new state is shown; complete when the changed setting visibly shows its new state on screen. Surface pinned: the settings pages of a major account or device. Variants: VPN marketing, general privacy-advice talking heads, jailbreak/bypass content, and enterprise admin-console content do not belong.
pwreset: reset a password or recover access to an online account (Gmail, Amazon, Facebook, any web login): start from the sign-in page's forgot-password link, prove identity through a second channel — email link, SMS code, or backup codes — set a new password, sign in; complete when signed in, or a password-changed confirmation is on screen. Surface pinned: the web or in-app login flow of an online service — NOT a phone's device-unlock, factory-reset, or activation-lock flow. Variants: phone unlock or activation-lock bypass, changing a password you already know, and setting up 2FA do not belong.
recipe: find a recipe that matches specific constraints and save it (Allrecipes, Cookpad, Food Network Kitchen, Paprika, Pinterest recipes, NYT Cooking): search for a dish, apply the constraints that matter (dietary restriction like gluten-free/vegan, excluded ingredient, time limit, rating), open a matching recipe, check its ingredient list against the constraints, and save/bookmark it to a collection; complete when the saved state (recipe in favorites/collection) is on screen. Surface pinned: a recipe site or cooking app's search and save flow. Variants: actual cooking footage (kitchen videos) as the main subject, recipe-development/food-blogging business content, meal-kit unboxings, and "what I eat in a day" content do not belong.
rentcar: rent a car online (Enterprise, Hertz, Turo, Expedia cars): pick a location and dates, choose a vehicle, review add-ons (insurance, young-driver fees, fuel policy), and book; complete when the reservation confirmation is on screen. Surface pinned: a car-rental website or app. Variants: car-rental business and fleet content, rental-car reviews and vlogs, and airport pickup vlogs without the booking flow do not belong.
reorder: reorder a previous online order with a modification (grocery or food apps: Walmart, Instacart, Amazon "buy again", DoorDash reorder): open order history, use the reorder or buy-again feature, adjust the cart (swap or remove an item, change a quantity), and check out; complete when the order confirmation is on screen. Surface pinned: a grocery or food-ordering website or app. Variants: first-time ordering (that is ordinary shopping), couponing content, and delivery-driver content do not belong.
restaurant: reserve a restaurant table online (OpenTable, Resy, Yelp reservations): set party size, date, and time, pick the restaurant, choose an available slot, identify, confirm; complete when the reservation confirmation is on screen. Surface pinned: a reservation website or app. Variants: ordering takeout or delivery, joining a same-day waitlist, and cancelling or modifying an existing reservation do not belong.
returns: return an item for a refund on a retail site (Amazon returns, Walmart, Target): locate the order in order history, find the return path, choose the reason and the refund/drop-off method, confirm; complete when the return confirmation — refund amount plus label, QR code, or drop-off instructions — is on screen. Surface pinned: the retailer's website or app order pages, not a store returns-desk vlog. Variants: disputing a card charge (seeded variant), cancelling an order before it ships (seeded variant), and warranty claims do not belong.
review: leave a review or rating (Amazon, Google Maps, Yelp): find the product or business, open the review flow, set the star rating, write the text and optionally add photos, submit, and verify it is live or pending; complete when the submitted review — or its under-review acknowledgment — is on screen. Surface pinned: the review flow of a shopping site or a maps/local-reviews platform. Variants: responding to reviews as a business owner and rating without any submitted review flow do not belong.
ride: get a ride with a rideshare app (Uber, Lyft; paratransit and access services count as sites): set pickup and destination, compare ride options and price, request, get matched with a driver, track the approach on the map, and verify the car and driver at pickup; complete when the ride is in progress or finished with the fare screen — at minimum, the matched-driver tracking screen after the request commits. Surface pinned: a rideshare app. Variants: driving for the platform (driver side), food delivery, and renting a car do not belong.
sharefile: share a file, folder, or photo album with specific people at the right permission level (Google Drive, Google Photos, Dropbox, OneDrive, iCloud): pick the item, open the sharing dialog, add people or create a link, set the permission (viewer/commenter/editor; link scope), send the invite or copy the link, and verify who has access; complete when the shared state (the people list, or the created link with its permission) is on screen. Surface pinned: a cloud storage or photos service's share flow. Variants: file-transfer-service marketing, torrenting, IT-admin tenant sharing policies, and camera/photography content do not belong.
shipping: ship a package by buying postage online (USPS Click-N-Ship, FedEx, UPS, PirateShip): enter sender and recipient addresses, package size and weight, choose a service and speed, pay, and get the label printed or a QR drop-off code; complete when the purchased label or drop-off QR code is on screen. Surface pinned: a carrier or postage website/app — not a post-office counter vlog. Variants: tracking a package after it ships, freight or international customs paperwork beyond the standard form, and returns-label flows inside a retailer do not belong.
signup: sign up for a service or free trial (Netflix, Spotify, streaming and consumer apps): open the join flow, create the account with email/password or single sign-on, verify email or phone if asked, pick the plan or trial, and land inside the new account; complete when signed in to the new account — the welcome or home screen — after any plan step. Surface pinned: the service's website or app signup flow. Variants: cancelling the trial later, password recovery on an existing account, and installing the app without creating an account do not belong.
socialbrowse: browse a social feed or forum to find specific content (find top or rising posts in a subreddit, open a community's latest discussion, find posts about a topic, sort or filter a feed): apply the right sort or filter, locate the target content, and open it; complete when the target post or discussion is on screen. Surface pinned: reddit, X/twitter, forums, and community sections. Variants: growing-your-account creator content, drama commentary, and social-media-detox content do not belong.
socialpost: publish a post to social media (Instagram, X, Facebook, TikTok): compose the post — text, photo, or clip — add caption and tags, preview how it will look to the audience, publish, and verify it is live; complete when the published post is visible on the profile or feed. Surface pinned: a social platform's posting flow on app or web. Variants: direct messages, editing the video/photo content itself, and growth or algorithm advice do not belong.
stock: buy a specific amount of a stock or crypto in a retail app (Robinhood, Coinbase, Fidelity, Cash App): search the ticker, enter a dollar amount or share count, review the order (price, fees), place it, and see the filled or pending confirmation; complete when the order confirmation is on screen. Surface pinned: a retail brokerage or crypto app or website. Variants: trading-strategy and technical-analysis content, price-prediction videos, and day-trading courses do not belong.
support: reach a live human at customer support (Amazon, airlines, banks): start from the help pages, navigate the bot and menu maze, choose the paths that lead to a person, and get connected; complete when a live agent is engaged — a human replying in the chat window, or a call/callback connected to a representative with the flow visible on screen. Surface pinned: the company's help/contact flow on web or app; audio-only phone calls with nothing on screen do not count. Variants: solving the issue through FAQ self-service, and the substantive dispute after the agent is reached, do not belong.
takeout: order food for delivery or takeout on a food delivery service (DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub): pick a restaurant, build the order with item options, review fees and tip, check out; complete when the order-placed confirmation or live order tracker is on screen. Surface pinned: the web or mobile-app interface of a food delivery service — not a phone-call order or a cooking video. Variants: reserving a table, grocery delivery, and receiving/verifying the arrived order do not belong.
taxes: file a personal tax return online (TurboTax, FreeTaxUSA, H&R Block): enter or import income documents (W-2, 1099), work through the interview screens, review the refund-or-owed summary, e-file; complete when the return-submitted / e-file confirmation is on screen. Surface pinned: the web interface of a tax-filing service. Variants: checking refund status afterwards, filing through a human accountant, and standalone refund-estimator calculators do not belong.
telehealth: have or set up a telehealth visit (Teladoc, Amwell, MDLive, Sesame, a health system's video-visit flow): sign in, request or schedule a visit, work through the intake questions, pass the camera/mic tech check, and join the video visit or reach the visit-confirmed or waiting-room state; complete when the in-visit screen or the confirmed-visit state is shown. Surface pinned: the telehealth product's flow — not telehealth-industry commentary, not in-person clinic vlogs. (Booking an in-person appointment belongs to doctor; records belong to patientportal.)
tickets: buy event tickets online (Ticketmaster, StubHub, AXS): find the event, pick seats or a price tier from the seat map, face the fees at checkout, pay; complete when the order confirmation with the tickets is on screen. Buying resale tickets is still buying a ticket and belongs; the frozen definition names primary-vs-resale explicitly. Surface pinned: a ticketing website or app. Variants: selling or listing tickets, transferring tickets to a friend, and scanning in at the venue do not belong.
tracking: track a package or order (Amazon orders, UPS/FedEx/USPS tracking): find the tracking entry from the order — or enter the tracking number on the carrier site — open the status page, read the scan history, and interpret where the package is and when it will arrive; complete when the current status and expected delivery are on screen and read out. Surface pinned: a carrier tracking page or retailer order-status page on web or app. Variants: filing claims for lost packages, and receiving or verifying the delivery at the door, do not belong.
tutoring: find and book a tutor on a tutoring platform (Preply, Wyzant, italki, Varsity Tutors, Cambly, Outschool): search by subject or language, compare tutors on rates, reviews, and intro videos, pick one, and book or schedule a trial or lesson through to the booking confirmation; complete when the booked-lesson confirmation is on screen. Surface pinned: the CLIENT-side booking flow — tutor-side content (how to become a tutor, earnings) is off-task.
twofa: turn on two-factor authentication or run a security checkup on an account (Google, banks, social accounts): open the security settings, choose a second factor — authenticator app, SMS, or passkey — scan or enter and verify the code, save backup codes if offered; complete when the settings page shows 2FA enabled or the checkup finished. Surface pinned: account security settings on web or app. Variants: password reset or account recovery, disabling 2FA, and signing in with an existing second factor do not belong.
unsubscribe: unsubscribe from marketing emails and clean up an inbox (Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo Mail): find the unwanted sender or use the unsubscribe affordance, confirm the unsubscribe, and/or bulk-select and delete, archive, or block; complete when the unsubscribed confirmation or the cleaned mailbox state is on screen. Surface pinned: a webmail or mail app inbox. Variants: email-marketing (sender-side) content, inbox-zero productivity philosophy talking heads, and third-party cleanup-app ads as the main subject (Clean Email/Unroll.me demos are fine if they show the real flow) do not belong.
usedcar: research and price a used car as a buyer: set the search filters that matter (make/model, year range, budget, mileage, drivetrain), browse the matching listings, open a specific listing and check its history and price rating, and get a price estimate or value for a specific vehicle; complete when a specific car's listing with its price evaluation (e.g. good/fair deal rating or KBB value) is on screen. Surface pinned: a used-car marketplace or pricing site (KBB, CarGurus, Carvana, AutoTrader, Edmunds). Variants: car-dealer/dealership-side content, car-flipping or reselling business content, car review vlogs with driving footage, and mechanic-inspection videos do not belong.
uspscoa: submit an official USPS change-of-address (mail forwarding) online: go to the USPS movers/change-of-address flow on usps.com, choose individual, family, or business and the move date, enter the old and new addresses, complete the identity verification step, pay the identity-verification fee if shown, and submit; complete when the change-of-address confirmation (confirmation code on screen or confirmation-email notice) is on screen. Surface pinned: the official USPS website flow. Variants: moving-company or moving-tips content, USPS mail hold (that is a different USPS task), address changes on other services (banks, DMV, IRS), and third-party paid change-of-address sites or scam-warning content as the main subject do not belong.
videocall: set up or join a video call (Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams): either create/schedule a meeting and invite someone, or join with a link or code; work through the audio/video device prompts and arrive in the live meeting; complete when the in-meeting screen with the user's own audio/video controls is shown. Surface pinned: the meeting product's own host/join flow — not webinar spectating, not call-quality reviews, not presentations ABOUT video calling.
videoedit: edit a video in a video editor (CapCut, iMovie, DaVinci Resolve, Premiere, Clipchamp): import footage, make concrete edits — trim or split clips, add captions or text, add music or adjust audio, apply transitions or speed changes — and export the result; complete when the export finishes (the saved/share screen or the rendered file is shown). Surface pinned: the editing session itself — not editing-theory talks, not before/after showcases without the session. One-click AI editing flows (auto-edit, AI video generators like Sora or Runway) are off-task; ordinary tool features such as auto-captions used inside a manual edit are fine.
webdesign: design and publish a simple website in a site builder (Wix, Squarespace, Webflow, WordPress.com, Google Sites, Carrd): choose a template, edit pages and content (text, images, sections), configure the essentials (site name, domain path), and publish; complete when the published site's live URL is shown or visited. Surface pinned: the builder session — not web-design-theory videos, not code-from-scratch HTML/CSS courses. AI site builders (Wix ADI, 10Web, one-prompt site generators) are off-task: the arc must be manual template editing and publishing.
